summary: Analyst Training Center (Forge Training) — full backend + frontend + AI-integration verification. 17/17 backend pytest cases pass (auth, CRUD, list search/filter, attachment upload/download/delete, 10MB cap 413, config persona persistence + 10k cap, regression). UI flow verified end-to-end (persona save, create/list/select/update/delete example, upload attachment via file input). AI integration confirmed: persona wording ('CUSTOMER', 'NivX CSOC recommends the following remediation steps') applied to newly-generated report without leaking specific IOCs/hostnames from the seeded training example while accurately reflecting the new alert (host HOST-QA-77, payload.exe, 5.6.7.8).

issues: Repeated React console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key, NaN'. Not blocking Forge Training but should be traced (likely another component rendering a list with NaN key). Pre-existing across pages.

action_items: Investigate the pre-existing React warning 'two children with same key NaN' — appears on many admin/public pages, unrelated to Forge Training but polluting console.
Consider surfacing 413 upload-cap error as a user-visible toast in the attachment UI (not verified — was not part of the flow tested).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L4783-4788: `delete_forge_training_attachment` has a dead / no-op tuple expression `(drop, keep) if a.get('id')==att_id else (keep, drop)` — harmless but confusing. Recommend deleting that line; the following if/else already handles the logic.

Persona is silently truncated to 10 000 chars server-side (no 400). Acceptable but the spec-defined 'max 10k' is enforced by truncation, not rejection — worth clarifying to caller (frontend has no visible counter/warning).
server.py is now 6600+ lines. Continue splitting NivX Forge subsystem into a dedicated module for maintainability.
